place.name: Museums of the Far East
place.description: The Museums of the Far East (French: Musées d'Extrême-Orient; Dutch: Musea van het Verre Oosten) is a complex of three museums in Laeken, in the north-west of the City of Brussels, Belgium. Consisting of the Chinese Pavilion, the Japanese Tower and the Museum of Japanese Art, it is dedicated to Oriental art and culture, specifically that of China and Japan, and forms part of the Royal Museums of Art and History (RMAH).
